Definition
[the two conformal forms of a warped product]

Source: petersen:page-0150, petersen:page-0151 ↗ def:pet-ch4-conformal-change ↗ def:pet-ch4-warped-product-general A warped product $dr^2+\rho ^2(r)g_H$ can be written conformally in two ways, via $dr=\psi (\rho )d\rho $: \[ dr^2+\rho ^2(r)g_H=\psi ^2(\rho )\big(d\rho ^2+g_H\big)\quad \text{when }\rho (r)=\psi (\rho ), \] \[ dr^2+\rho ^2(r)g_H=\psi ^2(\rho )\big(d\rho ^2+\rho ^2g_H\big)\quad \text{when }\rho (r)=\rho \psi (\rho ). \]
